data.name: Dreamshore
data.detailed_description:
A relaxing game about creating beautiful seaglass mosaics.

Collect colourful pieces of seaglass as they wash up on the shores of dreamy beaches, then bring them back to your cozy workshop and turn them into beautiful mosaics.

A satisfying combination of problem solving and creativity, each mosaic lets you experiment with different shapes and colours to fit them together how you like. Unlock new designs and new beaches to chill at, and discover a gentle, heartfelt story about burnout and reconnecting with creativity.

Features:

  • Creative mosaic-making, where you choose how to arrange the glass within each design.

  • Mysterious, dream-like beaches where you can watch the waves, collect seaglass or just relax in the ambience.

  • More designs, colours and special shiny pieces to discover as you progress.

  • Slow-paced gameplay, with no pressure or time limits.

  • Simple, tactile controls to place and arrange pieces.

  • A relatable story about burnout and creativity.
